Subject: Decision requested: six-week invoice-handling pilot

Morgan,

I recommend we approve a six-week pilot to assess invoice handling. Production rollout is excluded.

The fee is $30,000, fixed. The pilot will test whether handling time can move toward the hoped-for 20% reduction. No baseline or measured savings exists, so the pilot is an assessment, not a savings commitment.

Security approval is required before any access to client data. No start date has been approved, so timing can follow clearance.

Please approve the pilot scope and fee, subject to security clearance. That decision lets us proceed without committing to production.

Jordan  
Engagement lead
